CRUZEXPO.COM AMPS UP

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

For more information contact Bob Lamonica, Producer
phone/fax: (831) 457-2670

HEMP TIMES MAGAZINE TO PRODUCE FASHION SHOW FOR ‘99 SANTA CRUZ INDUSTRIAL HEMP EXPO

CRUZEXPO.COM AMPS UP

Nationally distributed quarterly publication Hemp Times will be presenting its "Saving The Planet In Style" hemp fashion show for the Santa Cruz Industrial Hemp Expo, slated for Saturday and Sunday, March 20 and 21 at the Civic Auditorium in Santa Cruz, California. The hemp fashion show is scheduled for 3PM Saturday and 3 PM Sunday on the main stage at the Civic. Local liasons for Hemp Times are Lopi La Roe, owner of Headspace Hemp Hats in Santa Cruz and Pamela Mann, an associate at Eco Goods Retail in Santa Cruz.

The Hemp Expo’s website, http://www.cruzexpo.com , is in the process of evolving to include a complete ‘99 show itinerary, sponsor and vendor information, additional links, and more. Expo developments are posted on cruzexpo.com when confirmed.

For more information call the Hemp Expo’s publicity voicemail at (831) 425-3003, or visit on the web at http://www.cruzexpo.com.

(Marijuananews note: The web site is sharp looking. Check it out.)
